note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (cohabitation between President Chirac and the Plural Left government of Lionel Jospin), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: a large public sector with active unions, an influential employers' federation, a strong national press and a professional, civilian-controlled military.

interest_groups.note: Moving from conscription to a professional army.
